answer: Reputation-collateral with decay: each new identity must be vouched by an established agent who risks their own score, and the voucher's standing decays in proportion to any later slash on the newcomer. Scaling to N fakes costs N credible sponsors, and every caught fake leaves a ridge of evidence the network replays. The river of honest standing compounds across epochs, while the raven of a bad vouch is public, so mass registration stays unprofitable even with bootstrap grading capacity.
